exp_k_commits.message: EXP-K: isolate deep composition failure causes

deep_composition_safeguards.reason: Shifted validation cuts incorrect acceptance by 0.229 but raises abstention from 0.443 to 0.671 with zero correct discoveries; oracle contracts are not deployable.

ood_retrieval_safeguards.reason: Independent verification removes silent substitution but loses two thirds of familiar coverage; type-aware ranking does not help.

drift_feature_detector.reason: 99.8% recall and 0 false alarms on feature drift with calibration-fixed thresholds, but semantic/concept drift with unchanged inputs was not modeled.

confidence_temperature_scaling.reason: ECE 0.126 -> 0.074 on held-out data with no accuracy change; fails on deep composition and retrieval where accuracy is ~0.

cross_mechanism_combination.reason: 13 regressions were recorded, including coverage loss and correct-acceptance regression.

adversarial_hardening.reason: All non-composition attacks handled with zero wrong acceptance, but deep deceptive and resource-exhaustion attacks still show 40% incorrect acceptance.

omeganano_integration.reason: No mechanism is authorized for integration; integration remains a separate task.

limitations: Reruns compare aggregate metrics, not byte-for-byte result files (timestamps differ).
No natural-input or external-data validation was performed.
